subject: SDLC evidence handoff: PR sampling & CI control mapping
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@acme-pharma.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood-inference.com
Cc: patrick.oneil@acme-pharma.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: sample PRs + CI control mapping for SIG review

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. Our audit team is starting the evidence collection for the SIG questionnaire and we need a small, well-scoped bundle that demonstrates your secure SDLC controls. Specifically we're looking for: 

- A PR sampling plan that shows how code reviews are selected and tracked (preferably a CSV or simple manifest).
- A one-sheet mapping of CI/CD controls to SIG/SOC2 control IDs (tooling, gate checks, who approves, and log retention windows).
- A screenshot or export of a recent successful CI run that exercised the gating checks (branch protection + secret-scan + dependency policy).

If you can deliver those artifacts by EOD Wednesday (your timezone), that will let our assessor include them in the first pass. Small attachments are fine — we prefer concise artifacts rather than a giant bundle. If there are any constraints (redactions, ephemeral logs) let me know the alternative evidence we can accept.

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Morales
Sr. Information Security Manager, Acme Pharmaceuticals
elena@acme-pharma.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0199
From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@acme-pharma.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood-inference.com, rachel_kim@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sample PRs + CI control mapping for SIG review

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can do that and keep it intentionally small. Plan below: 

1) PR sampling plan: we'll provide a CSV (redwood_pr-sampling-plan.csv) that lists the selection criteria (random stratified by repo & risk tag), the PR IDs sampled, reviewer IDs, and timestamps. We’ll include a short note about our policy for reviewer rotation.

2) CI control mapping: a one-page spreadsheet (ci-control-mapping.xlsx) that maps our pipeline stages to SIG/SOC2 criteria (e.g., branch protection, required approvals, secret scanning step, dependency-check stage, artifact signing). We'll flag any controls that are implemented via third-party integrations.

3) CI run export: a PNG export showing a representative pipeline execution with the gating checks passing (ci-run-snapshot-20290521.png). Where logs are ephemeral or redacted we’ll provide pointers to the policy and retention windows.

Logistics: we will upload the artifacts to a shareable Drive folder and send you a link. For PHI/PII concerns — none of the artifacts will include customer data; we will redact commit messages if they contain sensitive issue IDs. Let us know if you need native files or PDFs.

I’ll be the primary owner for the deliverable; Sean will help with the CI export and Rachel will prepare the mapping sheet. Estimated delivery: Wednesday 10:00 AM PT (2029-05-22T10:00:00-07:00).

Short Q: for the PR sampling CSV, do you want us to include commit SHAs or just PR URLs?

Thanks,

Grace O'Connor
Manager, Developer Experience — Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood-inference.com
--

Elena — delivery attached (links and attachments below). Quick notes included inline.

Attachments (attached to this message as stubs):
- redwood_pr-sampling-plan.csv (CSV; 15 rows; PR URL & commit SHA, reviewer, labels, reason sampled)
- ci-control-mapping.xlsx (XLSX; maps pipeline stages -> SIG/SOC2 control IDs; includes owner and retention windows)
- ci-run-snapshot-20290521.png (PNG; representative run showing secret-scan -> dependency-check -> integration stage)

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Acme-SDLC-evidence-index (internal access tokened link)
HubSpot record: HUBSPOT-REF-78421

Summary of the artifacts: 
- PR sampling: We use stratified random sampling across public repos and repos tagged "high-risk". The CSV includes PR link, latest commit SHA, reviewer, number of review comments, and the final merge timestamp. Any internal-only repos are noted in the final column.

- CI mapping: The spreadsheet maps each pipeline stage to the control owner and evidence type (pipeline YAML, test coverage report, policy check screenshot). Retention: pipeline run metadata retained for 90 days; signed artifacts retained for 365 days.

- CI run snapshot: caption: "Pipeline run 2029-05-21 — secret-scan (passed), dependency-check (passed, vuln policy 0.1 threshold), integration-tests (passed)."

If you need native log exports (JSON) for a small subset we can provide a timeboxed export under an NDA addendum. Otherwise, these artifacts should be sufficient for the SIG initial review.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether the assessor needs any additional context (e.g., policy excerpts or reviewer rotation logs).

Thanks — Grace
